plugins.name: helpwright
plugins.description: Adds a browsable, zero-dependency help/docs system to any project — or maps its Claude Code automation surface in developer-docs mode. Detects the framework (vanilla, React, Flask, Electron, Tauri, Deno, VS Code), scaffolds the shell, authors content from the real codebase, generates word-free infographics, and keeps it current with a maintainer agent.
